tasks.title: Audit the existing evidence and requirements
acceptanceCriteria: Canonical documentation and fixtures are inventoried
Known prerequisites and unresolved production decisions are identified
tasks.notes: Verified against docs/README.md, architecture invariants, open questions, glossary, fixtures, and business-requirement headings.

tasks.title: Profile sample PDFs and produce the field inventory
acceptanceCriteria: Each sample has tagged descriptive observations
Section and field inventory includes cardinality and provenance
Cross-sample patterns and anomalies are separated
Unknowns are added to the open-question log
tasks.notes: Basic intake is recorded in docs/expected-analysis/pdf-evidence-gap.md. Exhaustive profiling and field-inventory documentation are deferred because they are not required for the prototype; use samples only for short directional visual checks. S001 must be replaced with a de-identified copy before sample PDFs are committed.

tasks.title: Confirm production-blocking domain decisions
acceptanceCriteria: Lifecycle and transition set are confirmed
Snapshot boundary and identifier reuse policy are confirmed
Roles, jurisdiction, retention, and integration boundaries are confirmed
Decisions are recorded in the resolved log
tasks.notes: Deferred outside the current one-to-two-user report-generation prototype. Reopen individual decisions only if they directly block SCOPE.md or the owner expands scope.

tasks.title: Record core architecture decisions
acceptanceCriteria: Canonical payload and version identity decision passes INV-1 through INV-10
Lifecycle and audit decision names unresolved assumptions
Catalog snapshot decision names visible failure behavior
tasks.notes: Verified in ADR-0001 through ADR-0003: canonical identity/payload is checked against INV-1 through INV-10, lifecycle assumptions and production blockers remain explicit, and snapshot/error behavior is recorded. Accepted only for the reversible fixture-driven slice.

tasks.title: Create reproducible project scaffold
acceptanceCriteria: Runtime and dependency versions are pinned
A clean checkout has documented install, verify, build, and start commands
Formatting, lint, type checking, and unit tests run from one verification command
Example environment contains no secrets
tasks.notes: Verified with a clean npm ci and full verify/build on the pinned Node 24.20.0 and npm 11.19.0 runtime. README documents install/verify/build/start; .env.example is non-sensitive. Technology choice remains reversible scaffolding.

tasks.title: Add continuous verification
acceptanceCriteria: CI installs from the lockfile
CI runs the same verification command used locally
Build artifacts and secrets are excluded from version control
tasks.notes: Verified .github/workflows/ci.yml uses the committed lockfile via npm ci, runs the local verify command plus build, and pins actions by commit SHA. Generated output, local environments, logs, and GitNexus data are ignored; repository scans found no secret-like values or generated artifacts.

tasks.title: Provide a local task dashboard
acceptanceCriteria: An .mjs entry point reads docs/tasks/tasks.json
Summary counts and full task details can be viewed locally
Invalid statuses, duplicate IDs, and missing dependencies fail visibly
Dashboard does not mutate the task file
tasks.notes: Implemented as a dependency-free local server with API/detail filters and read-only validation; covered by the dashboard test suite.

tasks.title: Validate domain fixtures and define typed contracts
acceptanceCriteria: Catalog and report fixtures validate with actionable errors
Contracts separate clinical, catalog, and presentation state
Historical resolved values do not require current catalog rows
tasks.notes: Verified fixture parsers report actionable JSON/schema paths, JSDoc contracts and canonicalization keep catalog/envelope/presentation metadata outside clinical comparison, and historical snapshots are self-contained. Scope is the supplied fixture schema only; no production schema claim.

tasks.title: Implement explainable semantic comparison
acceptanceCriteria: Comparison identifies added, removed, and changed clinical values
Presentation and issue metadata are excluded
Equality is explainable without a fingerprint
Expected comparison fixture passes
tasks.notes: Verified added/removed/changed traversal in comparison.mjs and CMP-1 through CMP-4 tests: clinical paths and before/after values are explained, issue/presentation/provenance annotations are excluded, and equality does not consult fingerprints.

tasks.title: Implement immutable finalization and amendment lineage
acceptanceCriteria: Finalization creates a stable immutable version and audit event
Amendment begins from the superseded resolved payload
Catalog V2 cannot alter the V1 historical payload
Lineage is queryable in both directions
tasks.notes: Verified deep-frozen copy-on-write finalization, audit events, historical-payload amendment cloning, V1 stability under Catalog V2, and bidirectional lineage/supersession evidence. This is in-memory domain behavior only; durability and concurrency remain SRV-001.

tasks.title: Add invariant acceptance test suite
acceptanceCriteria: Historical stability, amendment baseline, semantic equality, deleted reference, and audit reconstruction tests pass
Tests name the invariant they protect
Test failures explain the clinical risk
tasks.notes: Verified named INV-1 through INV-10 tests cover historical stability, amendment baseline, semantic equality, deprecated-reference readability/no remap, lifecycle audit evidence, and lineage reconstruction. Full suite passes 16/16; persistence-level reconstruction remains SRV-001.

tasks.title: Implement durable version and audit storage
acceptanceCriteria: Versions and audit events survive restart
Finalization is atomic and concurrency-safe
Recovery test reconstructs version lineage
tasks.notes: Production durability, restart recovery, and concurrency infrastructure are outside the current prototype scope. Use in-memory or simple local storage only if the prototype needs it.

tasks.title: Implement policy-neutral report use cases and in-memory adapter
acceptanceCriteria: Create draft, validate, finalize, retrieve history, compare, and amend are exposed through injected service ports
The in-memory adapter provides atomic report and audit writes with optimistic concurrency
Missing or deprecated references fail explicitly without partial persistence
Contract tests cover immutable results, concurrent finalization, and transaction rollback
tasks.notes: Verified by the service contract suite: six policy-neutral use cases use injected repositories, unit of work, clock, identity, and reference ports; the in-memory adapter provides per-report transaction isolation, explicit concurrency conflicts, rollback, and detached immutable results. This slice is for contract tests and local development only; restart durability, production storage, authorization, retention, and integrations remain open under SRV-001, DEC-001, and OPS-001.

tasks.title: Build presentation-neutral document model
acceptanceCriteria: Document model is derived only from a frozen report payload and explicit render config
Current catalog is not queried when rendering history
Content order is covered by tests
tasks.notes: Verified by six document-model tests: output is deterministic, deeply immutable, ordered only by explicit semantic configuration, detached from caller mutation, and derived from the frozen historical payload without current-catalog lookup. Missing optionals stay absent, amendment annotations stay outside visible clinical content, long/multiple rows remain layout-neutral, and incomplete mappings fail visibly. Sample-dependent styling and deterministic PDF generation remain open under DOC-002 and REN-002.

tasks.title: Generate deterministic clinical report PDFs
acceptanceCriteria: PDF includes correct clinical content and issue identity
Export records renderer/config version and checksum
Long text, pagination, missing optionals, and font fallback are tested
Renderer-only changes remain clinically equal
tasks.notes: Server-generated archival PDFs, export metadata, checksums, and renderer-retention work are deferred. The current prototype uses a print-ready browser view and the browser's Print / Save as PDF action.

tasks.title: Complete clinical production-readiness review
acceptanceCriteria: Threat model and privacy review are approved
Backup and restore exercise succeeds
Authorization and audit-access tests pass
Load and failure-injection targets pass
No real clinical data is enabled before release approval
tasks.notes: Enterprise production hardening is outside SCOPE.md and requires explicit owner approval before implementation.

tasks.title: Deliver the report preview and print prototype
acceptanceCriteria: npm start opens the report product rather than the internal task dashboard
A fixture-shaped report can be loaded or pasted and validated
The user can generate a readable house-format preview
The report view prints cleanly and supports browser Save as PDF
An end-to-end test covers data input through the rendered document model
tasks.notes: Verified end to end: npm start loads the initial sample, pasted/file JSON is validated server-side, all payload fields reach the document model and preview, the amended sample displays V2 and corrected value 129, print CSS provides an A4 report view, and Print / Save PDF invokes the browser print flow. The delivery dashboard remains available through npm run dashboard.
